coordinate_method: Latitude and longitude extracted from the destination encoded in each supplied Google Maps short-link redirect.
review_requirements: Confirm all point locations with the campaign team.
Replace generic Mosque names with specific names where available.
Supply reviewed Bangla and Japanese translations.
Supply approved images, captions, rights information and alt text before enabling photos.
Treat road, salt-farm and environmental point locations as representative until their full extents are digitised.
